features.description: Timer displays 25:00 on initial load
steps: Verify timer shows '25:00' in large font in center of screen
Verify circular progress ring is full (100%)

features.description: Start button begins countdown from 25:00
steps: Click 'Start' button (center button with play icon)
Verify timer changes to '24:59' within 1 second

features.description: Pause button stops countdown
steps: Wait for timer to count down to at least '24:50'
Click 'Pause' button (center button with pause icon)
Verify timer stops at current time
Verify button changes back to 'Play' icon

features.description: Reset button returns timer to full duration
steps: Wait for timer to count down to at least '24:00'
Click 'Reset' button (right button with refresh/rotate icon)
Verify progress ring returns to full (100%)

features.description: Skip button advances to next session type
steps: Click 'Skip' button (left button with forward icon)

features.description: Timer automatically switches from Work to Short Break
Circular progress ring animates smoothly
steps: Verify progress ring starts at 100% (full circle)
Observe ring decreases smoothly as timer counts down
At 12:30 (halfway), verify ring is approximately 50% full
Verify animation is smooth without stuttering

features.description: Session counter displays correctly

features.description: Long break triggers after 4 work sessions
steps: Complete 4 work sessions (or use skip to advance)
After session 4, verify mode switches to 'Long Break'
Verify session counter resets to 'Session 1 of 4'

features.description: Color changes based on session type
